newsitem.title: USA: Wotecki tabbed for USDA food-safety post-Sources.
newsitem.headline: Wotecki tabbed for USDA food-safety post-Sources.

text.p: Cathy Wotecki will be nominated by the White House for the post of agriculture undersecretary for food safety, sources said Monday.

Wotecki has been acting undersecretary for ag research for several months. Her nomination, along with that of Shirley Watkins for nutrition undersecretary, may be announced later this week, said one Senate staff worker.

Initially, Wotecki was forwarded as research undersecretaary but in the past few weeks the administration began looking at her for the food safety job, which includes responsibility for meat inspection.

When asked about the possibility that Wotecki would be named to the food-safety slot, Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman described her as well-qualified but did not directly respond to the question if she would get the job.
Watkins has been favored since early this year to get the nutrition slot.

Gus Schumacher, now head of the Foreign Agricultural Service, will be named undersecretary for farm and foreign ag progroams, according to USDA sources. His nomination has been pending since late winter.
An unnamed New Mexico official was cited as the front-runner for undersecretary for ag research, to succeed Wotecki.
Two other posts remain vacant at USDA -- the head of the Farm Service Agency, which runs the farm program, and the assistant secretary for administration.
